description: Semantic similarity of two texts for RAG, dedupe and matching: JSON body {a, b}, each up to 8,000 chars, any language. Returns a cosine score from bge-m3 embeddings plus a rough band (near_duplicate, high, related, weak, unrelated). Texts are not stored. Price $0.003 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"similarity":0.8123,"band":"high","metric":"cosine","model":"baai/bge-m3","dimensions":1024,"chars":{"a":23,"b":27}}
name: text_similarity
